notes: MA and high/low breadth denominators use only stocks with valid histories; missing histories are not counted as below MA or failing to make a new high.
robustness.py compares percentile windows and volume thresholds on common evaluable dates; it does not tune parameters.

Opening/intraday P statistics only use positive open prices and actually trading observations; closing P retains the frozen prior-limit pool where daily return is available.
A nonpositive prior-20-day median turnover amount makes the volume ratio unavailable rather than infinite; long suspensions cannot create an artificial unlimited volume signal.
